reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, and extracts getUpcomingDates' weekend logic into getAdjustedOccurrence so both handlers share it; the similar daily-skip/move rule in shared/schedules.ts is not reused or joined.

duplication.why: The weekend rule is now written once for both schedule handlers instead of being copied; the RSchedule setup/try-catch scaffolding is repeated between getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: The handler sits with the other schedule handlers in server/schedules/app.ts, but the weekend-adjustment helper is kept private there rather than next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts where the other sites take that rule from.

scope.why: Adds the handler, the small extraction it needs, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Small, readable and tested; the two-day look-around margin is coupled to the weekend rule only by a comment, and the config parameter remains untyped.
